{{Quote|It is a Jedi's duty to be familiar with many things.|Ring-Sol Ambase|<ref name="BOS" />}}
'''Ring-Sol Ambase''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kynachi (species)|Kynachi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Ring-Sol Ambase was discovered as an infant on his homeworld of [[Kynachi]] and taken to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Because he did not grow up on Kynachi, he did not share the golden hair color which distinguished his [[Kynachi (species)|species]] from [[Human/Legends|Humans]]; a trait which was based off of Kynachi diet. After entering the Order, Ambase did not have any contact with his biological family, though he studied his culture thoroughly during his time at the [[Jedi academy|academy]], familiarizing himself with the products of [[KynachTech Industries]] and their practices.<ref name="BOS" /> His [[Ring-Sol Ambase's brother|brother]] maintained a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] on Kynachi.<ref name="GCS">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref> Ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] after completing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and crafting his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Ambase befriend his colleague, Jedi [[Lanchu Skaa]], and remained close with him despite their constant assignment to journey missions. Partnered with Master [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on one such mission, Master Ambase discovered a young [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] floating in the void. Discovering him to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the Jedi pair took young [[Nuru Kungurama]] back to Coruscant to be trained as a Jedi.<ref name="BOS" />

===The Clone Wars===
When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Ambase dutifully reported to Coruscant and took up the role of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. At the behest of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Ambase took over the training of the young [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Nuru Kungurama, an orphaned apprentice whose original Master, Lanchu Skaa, died in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. When a KynachTech Industries circuit board was discovered amid the wreckage of the Confederacy's weapon the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], Master Ambase reported to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] where he was scheduled for a meeting in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]] with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself. Because of the Kynachi's neutrality, Palpatine thought it best if Master Ambase would lead an investigatory team to the planet to determine if they were knowingly supply the Confederacy with weapons technologies.<ref name="BOS" />

Departing Coruscant with [[Breakout Squad]], Master Ambase was unaware that his Padawan had stowed away on board the ship; even when it came under fire by Separatist ships which had blockaded Kynachi. Fleeing the ship aboard an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], Master Ambase's early sensations of Kungurama's closeness were confirmed as he boarded another pod directly behind his Master. The pods landed separately on the planet, and Ambase was rendered unconscious during the impact with the surface. Carried by his surviving clone troopers, Master Ambase was taken prisoner by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] hired by the elusive and mysterious [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Placed into a coma, Ambase's body was encased in a coffin and taken to a secure place on the [[Bogg 5|fifth moon of]] [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]].<ref name="BOS" />

===Confrontation===
{{Quote|You don't understand, Nuru. I was touched by the dark side of the Force. Part of me ''wanted'' to cut you down. That is no way for any Jedi to think. The war is over for me. And so is my life as a Jedi.|Ambase to Kungurama|<ref name="GCS" />}}
He eventually woke up and discovered he was held prisoner in [[Dooku's castle (Kohlma)|Dooku's castle]] with the clone trooper [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]]. They managed to escape in a [[Corona-class transport|''Corona''-class transport]] in an attack staged by Dooku. The two traveled to [[Bilbringi Depot]], where they destroyed a ship which had fired on them. Ambase was able to sense Kungurama on the depot, and mistook his Padawan's shock at the destruction of the other ship as a sign of his falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="DSR">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref> Sharp and Ambase hid nearby and watched Kungurama's freighter escape. The two refugees then returned to Coruscant, where they were joined by a pair of bounty hunters to recover the escape pod Kungurama had been found in. He infiltrated Master [[Harro Kelpura]]'s lab disguised as a Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]. Kungurama arrived in the middle of the attempt, carrying Ambase's lightsaber. The Master used [[Telekinesis/Legends|the Force]] to take his lightsaber back and engage in a short duel with his Padawan. Kungurama managed to talk him down and Ambase collapsed. He was taken to the Jedi Temple medical facility to recover. Five days later, Kungurama visited him, and Ambase revealed he was renouncing his path as a Jedi and expressed his intention to go to his brother's farm on Kynachi.<ref name="GCS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ring-Sol Ambase appears in [[Ryder Windham]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' young readers series.
